subject: Temporary preservation request for logs/backups — forensics review
messages:
From: Lina Ortega <lina@dataguard.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Dec 2029 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary preservation of logs and backups for compliance review

Hi Irene,

We need Redwoods help to preserve a subset of logs and recent backups for an inbound compliance review tied to a regulatory inquiry at one of our customers (HealthBridge). Specifically:
- Preserve application request logs and Helix KV snapshot shards for account HB-9143 for a 30-day forensic hold (starting Dec 6).
- Export audit logs (admin actions) covering Nov 1Dec 1 in a tamper-evident format.
- Isolate relevant immutable snapshots so they are excluded from normal purge windows.

Questions: can Redwood put a temporary retention-exempt tag on the relevant snapshots and KV shards? What lead time do you need to create an isolated export? We may need a short cross-border transfer to our legal SFTP (US-based) — please flag any DPA or subprocessor implications.

Ive ccd our internal counsel, Eva Sato, who will coordinate evidence requests. Wed appreciate a confirmation of feasibility and an estimate of engineering hours and any impact to your eviction/backup purge schedules.

Best,
Lina Ortega
Legal Ops | DataGuard Inc.
attachments: temp_preserve_request_form.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lina Ortega <lina@dataguard.com>, Eva Sato <eva.sato@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Dec 2029 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary preservation of logs and backups for compliance review

Thanks Lina 

We can support a short-term preservation for forensics, subject to legal signoff and a short ops window. High-level plan: 
1) Ops will create an immutable snapshot (tagged retention_exempt=true) and lock it from automatic purge.
2) We'll export a tamper-evident audit bundle (SHA256 + signed manifest) and deliver to your SFTP or DocuSign/escrow as requested.
3) For KV shards, we can produce a read-only dump and store it in an isolated bucket with HSM-wrapped keys; these will not be counted in normal eviction windows while the hold is active.

Ask from our side: please confirm exact account IDs (HB-9143) and a narrow timestamp range for the logs. Also confirm whether the data includes EU subjects so Kimberly can advise on cross-border transfer.

Marissa, Kim  looping you for ops and legal next steps. Im attaching the filled preservation intake form Lina sent.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Product Counsel | Redwood Inference
attachments: temp_preserve_request_form.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>

Irene, Lina 

Were generally comfortable with a time-boxed forensics hold (30-45 days) but we need a narrow scope and a short DPA addendum before we move copies off-platform or perform cross-border transfers. Requested next steps: 
- Lina/DataGuard: please sign the preservation intake and provide a POA/attestation that the request is lawful and narrow in scope.
- I will circulate a short DPA addendum (45-day preservation clause, limited export permission, audit trail obligations). Please review and return redlines.

Technical notes for record: if any exported bundle includes EU resident data, we require (a) SCC-compatible transfer language or customer KMS where possible; and (b) subprocessors list disclosure for the export path (we route through S3 and a transient export bucket).

Attaching a redline draft of the addendum for quick review.

Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
attachments: DPA_addendum_redline.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Dec 2029 08:39:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary preservation of logs and backups for compliance review

Thanks  ops can implement but need a 48-hour lead time for snapshot creation and export. Operational checklist below: 
- Confirm exact accounts and time ranges by EOD Dec 4.
- Ops will schedule a maintenance window Dec 6 02:00-04:30 PST to create immutable snapshots and export bundles. This avoids hot-path throttling.
- We will tag snapshots with retention_exempt and record an internal Run ID (run-3421).
- Export options: (A) push to your SFTP (preferred) OR (B) store in our escrow bucket with access controlled to DataGuard principals for 45 days.
- After hold expiry we will either purge or return the snapshots per signed addendum.

Link to the runbook: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/immutable-snapshot (internal). Ive attached the runbook excerpt and will produce the audit manifest (SHA256) at export time.

Marissa Cole
Lead SRE, Platform Ops | Redwood Inference

Irene / Kim / Marissa  thank you — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Confirming:
- HealthBridge (HB-9143) logs only; timestamp window Nov 01 2029  Dec 01 2029. No EU subjects included.
- We will sign the DPA addendum and e-sign the preservation attestation today.
- Preferred export: push to our SFTP (sftp.dataguard.com) with HSM-wrapped AES-256 and signed manifest.
- We approve the 45-day window (start Dec 6) and request DocuSign link to finalize.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
